1.

Secure we rest upon that Rock, Where no foe us reaches, Rest in that strong fortress, Which in all storms stands.

C.

Upon that lofty Rock we build Our hope, our salvation; It stands firm since former times, It stands firm in eternity.

2.

Rise yet around the lofty Rock The waves their wild threat, Nothing there us frightens, For they hush at its foot.

3.

O, what joy the lofty Rock Can grant each moment! O, what peace and power there flow Abundantly from its depths!

4.

Only in that Rock, Christ, Life and salvation we have; Flee also all earth’s treasures, He, our heart’s treasure, remains.

5.

The thought of that lofty Rock Fills us with blessed hope; Heart, soul, and spirit are lifted To the blissful realms above. Upon that lofty, etc.
